summary: Willamette NF lookout cabin on Dome Rock, built 1928 and replaced 1948; sources date its removal to 1951 or 1965; remains reported in an undated guide and a Forest Service trail leads to the site.

facts.design: 14x14-foot Supervisor Hall frame cabin (ground-level lookout house, no tower)
facts.status_note: Cabin gone by 1951 per FFLOS and firelookout.com, or removed about 1965 per the Forest Lookouts Oregon page; Oregon Hikers (undated guide) reports remains of the old lookout there

staffing.status: manned in 1929, 1932, 1935 and 1944 per newspaper items quoted by Forest Lookouts; no later staffing in the sources read

access.note: Dome Rock Trail #3381 is a Forest Service trail that leads to the former lookout site; the trail page reports wildfire impacts and no closure

visit.trail_note: Trailhead off French Creek Road (Forest Road 2223), reached by driving west from Detroit across the Breitenbush Bridge and seven miles past the Forest Road 2207 junction; Forest Service warns of Beachie Creek and Lionshead fire impacts

events.note: Standard lookout house built on Dome Rock; FFLOS gives 1928 for the 14x14 Supervisor Hall cabin
Otis Dike took up his work at the station in July 1929
Dome Rock manned in July 1932 with Battle Axe Mountain and Crescent Mountain
Paul Ratzeburg called back to duty as lookout
Jimmy Poole stationed there in summer 1944 until a knee injury sent him home; last staffing in the sources read
Coast and Geodetic Survey station description describes a low, one-story building with a pointed roof
Oregon Hikers says the lookout was replaced in 1948
FFLOS and firelookout.com say the cabin was gone by 1951; this may refer to the original 1928 cabin, see resolved_conflicts
Forest Lookouts Oregon page says the lookout was removed c.1965
Oregon Hikers says the 1948 structure was destroyed in 1965
Register photos dated September 19, 2000 show tie-ins, a cable, an anchor, concrete foundation pieces and a 1920s date etched into a step
Registered August 18, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS and firelookout.com say the cabin was gone by 1951. The Forest Lookouts Oregon page says it was removed about 1965, and Oregon Hikers says a 1948 replacement was destroyed in 1965. A 1947 survey description still shows a one-story building. The dates fit together if the 1951 date refers to the original 1928 cabin, which Oregon Hikers says was replaced in 1948. No source says so, so the story gives both dates and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: The brief has no height and the site is a ground-level lookout house, so no height is given. Current condition rests on an undated Oregon Hikers guide and 2000 register photos; no current photo was found. The removal date conflicts (1951 vs 1965) and is reported as a conflict. Newspaper items spell the 1944 lookout Jim or Jimmy Poole; the story uses Jimmy as quoted. No photos added. Fact-check 2026-10-09: all dates checked against the Forest Lookouts page (1928, July 5 and July 30 1929, July 7 1932, Oct 3 1935, Sept 1944, 1947 survey, c.1965); 'Forest Lookouts register' corrected to 'Former Fire Lookout Sites register'; the Oregon Hikers guide is undated, so its remains claim is stated without 'still'.
